# Investor Ready

> Investor Ready prepares pre-seed to Series A startups for investor due diligence. The 21-Day Investor-Ready Sprint builds a clean cap table, investor-grade financial model, valuation memo, pitch deck, data room and due-diligence pack in 21 days, with a Diligence-Proof Guarantee. Based in Accra, Ghana; works with founders in the US, UK, UAE, Singapore, India and Africa. Not a law firm, broker-dealer or registered valuer, and does not introduce founders to investors.

## Core offer
- [21-Day Investor-Ready Sprint](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/investor-ready-sprint.html): all eight files done for you; $18,000 (US).
- [Investor-Ready Audit](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/investor-readiness-audit.html): 5-day investor readiness assessment; from $1,500.

## Services
- [Clean cap table](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/cap-table-cleanup.html): SAFE and note conversion, option pool, dilution.
- [Financial model](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/startup-financial-model.html): driver-based 3-statement model and unit economics.
- [Startup valuation](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/startup-valuation.html): Scorecard, Berkus, VC method, comparables.
- [Pitch deck](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/pitch-deck-consultant.html): written and designed, with teaser.
- [Data room](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/investor-data-room.html): 8-folder seed data room checklist.
- [Due diligence preparation](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/due-diligence-preparation.html): red flags, Q&A bank, KPI pack.
- [Corporate structure](https://iabhinavv.github.io/Investor-ready/corporate-structure.html): Delaware flip and holding-company options.
